source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: The PDF has a real text layer (mixed with the diagonal icseboard.org watermark); text taken from it and checked line by line against the rendered page images. No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2022 comes from the file name (…-260922-2022, i.e. 26-09-2022). No marks are printed per question (only M.M-35); every item carries an editorial estimate of 1 mark, flagged on each question. Section B says 'Attempt any four' of six questions, so the item total exceeds 35. No school name printed. Watermark ignored.
